title: New sorting networks for n = 49 to 62
description:
Eleven sorting networks for 49 to 62 inputs that are not dominated by any entry in Bert Dobbelaere's list of sorting networks (version 'Page updated on Fri Nov 20 20:53:00 2026').

New size upper bounds: n=50 375 CEs (depth 24), n=55 431 (22), n=57 453 (24), n=58 464 (24), n=61 496 (24).

New (size, depth) pairs: n=49 (368,20), n=57 (457,20), n=60 (487,20), n=61 (497,21) and (501,20), n=62 (510,20).

Includes the networks in the table's format, exact verifiers (0-1 principle prefix product and a SAT check), broken-network controls, SorterHunter configs, seeds and logs.
